title: Projections extractor stdin
description: The document an extractor receives on stdin.

mode.description: How the revision is given: the user's checkout read in place, a reused workspace, a temporary materialization, or Git objects with nothing on disk.

root.description: The directory holding the examined revision. Absent in `git-objects` mode.

git.description: In `git-objects` mode: the Git directory and the examined tree.

project.description: The definition's project: the directory holding its `.github/projections` or `.projections`, relative to `root` (and to the Git tree in `git-objects` mode), `/`-separated; empty for the repository's root. The definition's paths and inputs are relative to it, and the extractor runs there. Absent means the root.

checkout.description: Where the repository's dependencies (such as `node_modules`) are installed for this run: the root itself in place or in a prepared workspace, or the user's checkout when a materialized revision borrows them; a nested project's are in its `project` directory there. Absent under container isolation and in `git-objects` mode.

scope.description: The enforced scope, repository-relative (the definition's own, resolved from its project): files outside it are not listed and reads fail.

items.description: A repository-relative file or directory, `/`-separated, without `.` or `..` segments.

upstream.description: The normalized extractions of the definition's `extractor.upstream` built-ins, keyed by the names the definition gives them. Present only when it declares some.

generations.description: Earlier generated values to reuse for an equal basis. Absent when the store is empty or the run regenerates.

file.description: A read-only JSON Lines snapshot of the generation store: one `{"path", "basis", "value"}` per line, keyed by a generated declaration's `path` and its basis digest.
